description: Hand-labeled privacy-policy excerpts for evaluating the policy extractor. label.deletionSupported is the ground truth.

items.text: You may request deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing privacy@shop.example. We will erase your account within 30 days.
We value your privacy and use industry-standard encryption. We may collect usage analytics and share aggregated, non-identifying statistics with partners.
Under GDPR you have the right to erasure. Submit the online data-removal form to have your information removed from our systems.
This policy explains what cookies we set and how to configure your browser. We retain logs for security purposes.
To exercise your right to be forgotten, contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@corp.example with proof of identity.
We process payments through third-party providers and do not store card numbers. Contact support for billing questions.
Account holders can permanently delete their account and all associated data from the Settings page. Deletion is irreversible.
Our services are provided as-is. We reserve the right to modify features. This section covers acceptable use and liability.
If you would like your personal data removed, please write to privacy@travel.example and we will action your removal request.
We may keep your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services and comply with legal obligations.
You can ask us to delete the personal information we have collected from you, subject to certain exceptions, via privacy@retail.example.
This notice describes how we use marketing cookies and how to opt out of targeted advertising through your device settings.
We are committed to transparency. Data is processed lawfully and stored securely on servers located in the EU.
Customers in California may request that we delete their personal information. Use the 'Do Not Sell or Delete My Info' link in the footer.
We do not delete personal data upon request; transaction records are retained indefinitely for compliance.
